notes.title: Update 0.94 released: LIV integration & tracker guns
notes.content:
- LIV mixted reality Integration.
- Add total compatibility with SteamVR imputs: Say hello to weapons with trackers like pp-gun.
- Other minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.75 released: Leaderboard fixes and faster start
notes.content:
- Now the game starts much faster.
- Fixed bug with leaderboards. We had to reset the records to fix it. Sorry for the inconvenience of Early Access.
- Improved the position and rotation of the gun using VIVE.
- Other minor bug fixes and improvements
- Coming soon: LIV mixted reality and integration with PP-Gun pistols and other pistols with trackers.

notes.title: Update 0.62 released: Haptic suit, sensitivity improvement, achievements and more
notes.content:
- Integration with Haptic suit bhaptics.
- Adjusted the sensitivity by default to make it easier to control beginner players.
- Steam achievements.
- Graphic performance Improvement. Now the game is even more fluid.
- Improved loading screen.

Coming soon: Integration with PP-Gun pistols and other pistols with trackers.
